Fingerprints are visible but have round target-like centers; elongate asymmetric loop flow.
Nail grain appears stamped/corrugated; lower amplitude and remove high-frequency phase perturbation.

geometry_02.verification: Independent geometry preservation and actual triangle intersections PASS for both hands.

nail_seating_diagnostic.cause: Full curl ray tested entire digit and hit proximal ring0/little0 webbing in both source and candidate, not the nail bed.
nail_seating_diagnostic.correction: Nail seating rays and nearest distances use skin owned by distal bone2>0.25; unchanged clearance/intrusion/gap thresholds. All 80 pose/digit cases passed. Whole-fist self collision is outside this seating check.

observed: Nail relief is smooth and subtle; prior stamped grain removed.
Dorsal curved transverse arcs replace bullseye rings; palmar elongated open loops replace circular targets.
Skin furrows look too regularly spaced like diagonal woven lines.
iteration_04.next: Increase local variation and reduce furrow spacing; retain improved nails, loop fingerprints and protected geometry.

iteration_05.observed: Fine furrows remain too straight and form a visible lattice, especially over the fingerprint.
iteration_05.next: Use different locally warped fields for each directional family, break their extent and attenuate skin cross-furrows on the fingertip pad.
